scope: Pinned source contract for transmission-gate observer implementation; no runtime island-state coverage claimed.

branchInitialization.excerpt:
vvp_island_branch_tran::vvp_island_branch_tran(vvp_net_t*en__,
                                               bool active_high__,
                                               unsigned width__,
                                               unsigned part__,
                                               unsigned offset__,
                                               bool resistive__)
: en(en__), width(width__), part(part__), offset(offset__),
  active_high(active_high__), resistive(resistive__)
{
      state = en__ ? tran_disabled : tran_enabled;
}

requirements: Register the private generic-event base key inside the owning island class; do not guess base offsets. Register identities without reading partially initialized derived or branch fields.
Observe all live islands, including unqueued ones: input/output caches and branch enable state persist after the queued wrapper is consumed.
Retain a registry of linked ports before compile_cleanup deletes symbol maps. Include enable-only import ports, not just the two branch endpoints.
Serialize flagged_, branch list/mesh endpoints, enable port, polarity, resistance and slice metadata plus initialized state. Validate links against registered objects before following them.
Serialize invalue, outvalue and value through logical vector8 accessors including both strengths. Empty scratch vectors are meaningful and must not be read as elements.
Keep wire/filter force state as an explicit remaining referent until observed. island_get_value can substitute forced values, so input caches alone are insufficient.
Test coalesced inputs, disabled/enabled/unknown enables, conflicting drivers, strengths and consumption/requeue, with original/disabled/observed/restored full-output controls.
Restore real cache, strength, flag, enable-state and mesh mutations before scheduler continuation; require unchanged unrelated state and exact restored snapshots.
